Adolion: Eshalanore
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
The Welcome of Eshalanore
Lanterns rise over a stone city among the trees, and its castle lays on a feast for travellers from the south; somewhere here are the Holts, and what to accept and ask is yours.
What happens next is yours to decide.
The scene is tense.
About this story
Widow Holt of Fennmarch has paid every coin she has for a C-rank job out of the Aegis City Adventurers Guild: go north past cursed Alks Forest and bring home her son and daughter, fur trappers who wrote that they were guests of the elves and would not be coming back. This is dark fantasy horror, where dread comes before violence and a kind welcome is not always what it seems. Bring your adventurer as they stand, with Belle and Dalan at your side.
Open threads
What Belle's mounting suspicion of the feast and the court will drive her to do.
Whether Elowyn will actually let the party see the Holt siblings tomorrow, or keep stalling, remains open.
What Belle will do if the trappers are not produced at dawn, given her threat to start breaking things, remains open.
Whether Belle will actually wait for dawn or force a confrontation before the promised meeting with the Holt siblings.
What Elowyn means by wanting to talk "about us" and "how you feel," and what she is steering Max toward.
The story so far
At a roofless chapel beneath the black pines, Ashliel offered the party shelter and urged them to turn back from the elven wood, warning that the Lady of the Forest does not permit outsiders to pass. Sali, a shapeshifting slime girl, emerged from the trees and joined them, while Max Nightriver first ordered the group to leave immediately, then relented and chose to wait for dawn. At first light, Max thanked Ashliel and led the party north across the shrine stones, and Ashliel followed despite her sorrow, saying she would not let them cross alone.

2 things the story picked up — they take effect on the next turn.

Retrying.
The story is deciding how the world answers that.

Max Nightriver and his party entered the castle hall, where Princess Elowyn greeted Max with unsettling familiarity, calling him the one she had been waiting for. At the feast, King Teranora gave evasive answers about the Holt siblings, and Elowyn deflected Max's questions while touching his shoulder and urging celebration. Belle grew openly hostile, refusing more wine and warning Max that something about the situation stank. After an hour the feast ended, Elowyn insisted they not leave yet, and the party was housed in a guest wing with Belle and Max in adjoining rooms. At dawn a servant summoned them to Elowyn, who again refused to let the Holt siblings be seen, saying they needed rest, and turned the conversation toward Max and Belle's feelings.

At a roofless chapel beneath the black pines, Ashliel offered the party shelter and urged them to turn back from the elven wood, warning that the Lady of the Forest does not permit outsiders to pass. Sali, a shapeshifting slime girl, emerged from the trees and joined them, while Max Nightriver first ordered the group to leave immediately, then relented and chose to wait for dawn. At first light, Max thanked Ashliel and led the party north across the shrine stones, and Ashliel followed despite her sorrow, saying she would not let them cross alone.
